question: Brihadaranyaka, Mundaka and Taittiriya are some examples of which of the following categories of religious texts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Upanishads**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brihadaranyaka, Mundaka, and Taittiriya **are examples of Upanishads, which are a category of religious texts in the Vedas. 
 
• **Upanishads**
 
 
• **​**These are a set of texts in the Vedas that are considered to be authorless and eternal creations. 
 
 
 
• The Upanishads are Philosophical texts.
 
• They are generally called Vedanta, as the came toward the end.
 
• Upanishad is **derived from the words upa (near) and shad (to sit)**.
 
• It is derived from the concept of sitting near the feet of the teacher.
 
• Vrihadaranyaka is the oldest Upanishada.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Feature
 Jataka Stories
 Epics
 Puranas
 
 

 Definition
 Stories about the previous births of Buddha.
 Long narrative poems about heroic deeds.
 Ancient texts containing mythology, legends, and cosmology.
 
 

 Origin
 Associated with Buddhist literature.
 Rooted in Vedic tradition and Hindu culture.
 Primarily part of Hindu religious tradition.
 
 

 Purpose
 Teach moral and ethical lessons.
 Glorify heroism, dharma, and values.
 Preserve myths, religious practices, and history.
 
 

 Examples
 Stories like "The Monkey King" and "The Golden Deer."
 Mahabharata, Ramayana.
 Vishnu Purana, Shiva Purana, Bhagavata Purana.
